one_line: Kalyani Chalukya-era legal scholar of the Mitakshara commentary on Yajnavalkya Smriti.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, medium build, dignified scholar’s posture
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, calm sharp eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard, a small white vibhuti line across the forehead, default expression thoughtful and composed
appearance.hair: black hair gathered into a modest topknot at the back of the crown, smooth front hairline, no shaved portion, with a soft off-white cotton uttariya (shawl) occasionally draped over the head when outdoors but usually resting on the shoulders
appearance.costume: era-accurate Deccan Brahmin scholar attire: a long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh, worn over a pale beige dhoti wrapped tightly and pleated to mid-calf, the dhoti border in muted maroon, an unpatterned sandalwood-brown waist sash tied on the left side, and a plain off-white uttariya with thin maroon edging draped over both shoulders and across the chest; simple leather sandals on the feet, a single small gold stud in each ear, and a narrow tulasi bead necklace at the collarbone, textiles mostly matte cotton with very subtle woven texture and minimal decoration.
appearance.signature: a neatly bound palm-leaf manuscript bundle of the Mitakshara in a brown cloth wrapper held in his left hand, with a smooth wooden stylus held lightly in his right hand as if ready to annotate.

ref_desc: Vijnaneshwara is a mid-40s Deccan scholar with a vibhuti-marked oval face, black topknot hair, off-white tunic, beige dhoti with maroon border, sandalwood-brown sash, off-white uttariya, carrying a wrapped palm-leaf Mitakshara manuscript and stylus in a muted off-white, beige, maroon and brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vijnaneshwara: a mid-40s, medium-build Deccan Brahmin scholar standing upright, with an oval medium-brown face, calm sharp eyes, straight nose, small white vibhuti line on his forehead, and a neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard. His black hair is gathered into a modest topknot at the back of the crown, with a smooth hairline and no shaved portion, and an off-white cotton uttariya rests on his shoulders rather than covering his head. He wears a long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh, a pale beige dhoti wrapped tightly and pleated to mid-calf with a muted maroon border, and a plain sandalwood-brown waist sash tied on the left side; the uttariya has a thin maroon edging and is draped over both shoulders and across his chest. Show simple leather sandals, a single small gold stud in each ear, and a narrow tulasi bead necklace at his collarbone. In his left hand he carries a neatly bound bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts wrapped in brown cloth, and in his right hand he lightly holds a smooth wooden stylus, posed as a thoughtful legal commentator. Use a restrained palette of off-white, beige, maroon, sandalwood brown, and black, with subtle cotton textures and overall dignified, scholarly energy.
